reasoning: The 1-week compounded euro short-term average rate closely tracks ECB policy rates. As of October 2026, I need to assess whether rates would increase between Oct 11 and Oct 18. Given the ECB's rate trajectory through 2024-2025 showed cuts from peak levels, by late 2026 rates are likely relatively stable or continuing gradual adjustment. Week-to-week changes in this rate are typically small and depend on ECB meetings. Without a scheduled ECB meeting between these dates, the rate would likely remain stable or show minimal movement. The probability of an increase vs decrease/unchanged is roughly balanced, slightly below 50% given the general easing trend.
